items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1978-08-02
items.q: Arthur Durny, Larry Cartrell and myself, there were three weeks, when we left New Orleans.

ctx.x: Yeah. Things do make a difference that way. Yeah. So, who was the Reed section when you first came to the piano?
Arthur Durny, Larry Cartrell and myself, there were three weeks, when we left New Orleans. And who was on third? Durny. He was playing the piano.
